scope: Actual Clight/extended-machine continuation composition and complete maintained fail_child source, including real fresh allocation, both put32 calls, source fault selectors, complete write_all and _exit(125).
input: Arbitrary 32-bit descriptor, stage and error words; independently owned writable TLS and stable mode/name strings at actual source symbols. No reporting success, desired outcome or execution assumed.
result: Every live finite prefix has ordinary enabled progress; no local return; transferred bytes are a prefix of the selected 0/3/8-byte report; every observed exit attempt uses 125. Returned write failures are ignored before exit, as in source.
nonvacuity: Actual allocations at source literal/mode symbols, independent TLS, and complete normal, dropped, short, failed and partial-loss executions for arbitrary argument words. Local inputs only; no whole-program initializer claim.
observation_boundary: Arbitrary waits, EINTR, partial transfers, failures and process loss retained. No termination, successful publication or Linux resource cleanup claimed. Source does not explicitly free its local before exit.
tool_profile: Unchanged pinned CompCert commit 14d616046360a0b2611ebdfc2f98368af402e1f7 (VERSION 3.17), Coq 8.18.0 and OCaml 4.14.1. Source/frontend/extraction correctness remains trusted; no compiler preservation theorem applied to the extended machine.
deployment: No native, kernel, VM, runtime or hardware profile changed; preserved VM artifacts only.
